headlines.title: Trump names Stephen Miller his new chief of staff, replacing Susie Wiles
headlines.description: President Donald Trump has turned to MAGA favorite Stephen Miller to lead the White House after Republicans got trounced in Tuesday’s midterm elections, losing both chambers of Congress by wide margins.

headlines.title: Sen. Chris Murphy discharged from hospital after stroke
headlines.description: Sen. Chris Murphy, D-Conn., is being discharged from The Johns Hopkins Hospital after experiencing a “small hemorrhagic stroke” last weekend.

headlines.title: Top DOJ officials resign after midterm landslide, including head of ‘grand conspiracy’ investigation
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — The Donald Trump appointee who headed the office running a so-called “grand conspiracy” investigation looking into federal law enforcement officials who were involved in prior investigations of Trump has resigned.

headlines.title: Wiles’ significance as Trump’s longest-serving chief of staff
headlines.description: In a social media post, President Trump announced that Stephen Miller will replace Susie Wiles as the White House chief of staff. Miller has served as White House deputy chief of staff for policy and as a homeland security adviser, playing an integral role in the administration's hard-line immigration and deportation policies.

headlines.title: Judge blocks construction on Trump’s D.C.-area arch after approval
headlines.description: A federal judge temporarily blocked construction on President Donald Trump’s “Triumphal Arch” shortly after a planning commission led by Trump appointees approved it. NBC News' Gary Grumbach explains why U.S. District Judge Tanya Chutkan granted the restraining order.

headlines.title: Democrats won on affordability. Whether they can deliver it is a different story.
headlines.description: Fulfilling a campaign promise to bring down high prices is a lot harder than it sounds. Just ask Donald Trump.

headlines.title: Early midterm voting data shows enthusiasm ahead of election day
headlines.description: With millions of Americans having already voted, NBC News Director of Elections John Lapinski analyzes early midterm voting data and key races to watch on election night.

headlines.title: Judge blocks construction on Trump’s D.C.-area arch after commission’s approval
headlines.description: The Trump administration has said it expects to begin construction immediately, but a judge is considering a plan to temporarily halt the project.

headlines.title: Democratic socialist Nithya Raman defeats Karen Bass in the L.A. mayor’s race
headlines.description: NBC News projects the progressive City Council member has unseated Bass, a fixture of California Democratic politics who served one term as mayor.

headlines.title: Pete Hegseth strikes defiant tone in face of impeachment threat
headlines.description: Many lawmakers, including some Republicans, have criticized the defense secretary over his handling of the Iran war.

headlines.title: Rep. Ro Khanna allies launch a draft campaign for the 2028 presidential race
headlines.description: Exclusive: The California congressman has been traveling the country and building prominence among progressives.
